name: Track 1: Agentic AI - Foundations, Architectures, and Frameworks
description: Skillsoft issued completion badges are earned based on viewing the percentage required or receiving a passing score when assessment is required. This track builds a strong conceptual and architectural foundation for understanding how agentic AI systems operate. Learners explore what differentiates agentic AI from traditional models, focusing on autonomy, perception, reasoning, memory, feedback, and adaptation. The track then dives into the core architecture of agentic systems, showing how components interact to enable intelligent behavior, before introducing widely used agentic AI frameworks and how they map to the agent lifecycle. It concludes with agentic AI design patterns—reusable blueprints that guide reasoning, tool use, collaboration, and reflection—equipping learners to analyze, design, and reason about agentic systems with clarity and confidence.
